title: same_day_stale_bounce_stands_down_test fixture is now()-relative — the pin goes dormant in the ~1h after midnight
evidence:
SET attempts = jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('at', to_char(now() - interval '1 hour', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'), 'channel', 'email', 'outcome', 'delivered', 'detail', 'old_same_day')),
           status = 'awaiting_correction'::reference_call_status
detail: The send (now()-1h) vs corrected_at (now()) are same-day only outside the hour after midnight; crossing midnight puts the send on the previous day, where the lexical day-prefix compare also orders correctly — the exact same-day case r1/r2 got wrong would then pass even with the format-mix bug.
recommended_fix: Pin both instants explicitly: a fixed RFC3339 send (e.g. '2026-08-01T08:00:00Z') and corrected_at set to a fixed '2026-08-01 09:00:00+00' via a test-only UPDATE after do_correct.
